name: okturan-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins for file organization, repository audits, prose editing, and work-shaping.

plugins.name: files-organizer
plugins.description: Scan macOS storage, find duplicate and misplaced files, and build a self-contained HTML file map.

plugins.name: project-health
plugins.description: Score a Git repository across nine categories and show the checks and findings behind the score.

plugins.name: human-writing
plugins.description: Draft plain prose and rewrite text that carries common AI-writing patterns. Includes the /humanize command.

plugins.name: shape-the-work
plugins.description: Route work to OpenSpec Explore, Wayfinder, Long-Horizon Prompting, or no special mode. Includes a dependency check and explicit handoff rules.
